units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And I'm Ben. You've got a day ashore tomorrow, and we've got about fifteen minutes tonight.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Think of it as the briefing before the shore leave.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Five short chapters. What the city is.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Why it was so rich. How it lost the money.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Where Rubens fits in. And what to look out for tomorrow.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: And I'm placing a bet before we start.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: By the end of this, somebody will have mentioned a hand.
